items.prompt: Which shape has exactly one pair of parallel sides?
hints: Count the pairs of parallel sides in each shape.
Three of these shapes have two pairs.
items.explanation: A trapezium has one pair of parallel sides. A square, rectangle and rhombus all have two pairs.

options.why: A square has two pairs of parallel sides.
A rectangle has two pairs of parallel sides.
A rhombus has two pairs of parallel sides.

items.prompt: How many lines of symmetry does a regular pentagon have?
hints: A regular pentagon has 5 equal sides.
Each line goes from a corner to the middle of the opposite side.
There is one line for each corner.
items.explanation: A regular pentagon has a line of symmetry through each corner and the middle of the opposite side. That makes 5.

items.prompt: True or false: A square has 4 lines of symmetry.
hints: Count horizontal, vertical and diagonal lines.
items.explanation: It can be folded in half along 2 diagonals, and across 2 lines through the middles of opposite sides.

items.prompt: True or false: A rectangle that is not a square has 4 lines of symmetry.
hints: The two halves do not match.
items.explanation: It has only 2: one vertical and one horizontal. The diagonals are not lines of symmetry.

items.prompt: True or false: An isosceles triangle has two equal sides.
hints: Think about the meaning of isosceles.
items.explanation: Isosceles means two sides have the same length.

items.prompt: True or false: All rhombuses have four right angles.
hints: Can you lean a square over?
A leaning shape keeps equal sides.
items.explanation: A rhombus has four equal sides but its angles may not be 90 degrees. Only a square rhombus has right angles.
